newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen higher after Wall St rebound.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen higher after Wall St rebound.

text.p: French shares were seen opening higher on Wednesday, after a 2.8 percent drop on Tuesday, following Wall Street's rebound overnight, dealers said.
The Dow Jones index closed 27.57 points higher at 6,611.05 but this was only a small dents in the near 300-point total decline of its Thursday and Monday sessions.
In Paris, April CAC-40 futures were trading 15 points higher at 2,592. Bonds started higher while call money was unchanged.
* Lagardere Groupe set to report its 1996 results after market close.
